notes: The source file is a KNX export in CSV-like structure with section headers and nested room groupings.
Some columns in the export are empty or not fully normalized, so this documentation preserves the visible fields and groups devices by location.
The `Treppenhaus` section is present in the source excerpt, but no device row is shown under it.
eibPort and AppModule were added manually as system components because they are relevant to the installation but are not listed as ETS devices in the source export.
Across all rooms, the installation includes Hue White Ambiance E27 luminaires and CONSTALED 30022 LED-Strip DTW 5 m Rolle | 18 W/m, IP68.
